items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had Richard Williams at one time.

ctx.x: What is your – of the recordings that you did, what recordings did you – most pleased you with the Big B-A-D Band?

I like the Wichita one, the one live at Wichita. We had – Phil Woods was with us then. I think Phil Woods and Chris Woods were there, weren’t they? Jimmy Nottingham. We had Richard Williams at one time. We’ve had a lot of wailing cats in that band.
What about Clark Terry and his Jolly Giants?
